rationale: This is the safe host default and has the lowest historical hindcast SMAPE. Verified evidence contradicts its upward-drift assumption, but it also contradicts the other candidates: rolling_daily_selector remains near the spike level rather than the documented baseline, while backtested_power_tail continues rising. No executed candidate cleanly represents a stable baseline without upward drift, so the evidence does not justify overriding the best-hindcast candidate.
